description: This file contains shell functions intended to add markup for test outputs in GitHub workflows, including functions for starting test output, finalizing test case output, and management of markup files.

methods.name: start_test_output
methods.description: Initializes markup output for a test run, setting output file and ensuring required conditions.

methods.name: finalize_test_case_output
methods.description: Finalizes and outputs the result of a test case, appending appropriate markup or messages based on test outcome.
